steps.npc: I'm Gary, the wizard. I've not actually been qualified for very long, so I'm living here near the rune shop so I can keep practicing the magical arts.
I seem to be raising a cat, too, ever since some local lady persuaded me to buy one off her.

options.text: Is the cat supposed to help you get runes too?

steps.player: Is the cat supposed to help you get runes too?

steps.npc: No! I know there are places where people think it's normal to swap cats for runes, but that will NOT happen to Sookie!

options.text: If you're a wizard, are you doing anything magical?
If you're a wizard, are you doing anything magical?

steps.player: If you're a wizard, are you doing anything magical?

steps.npc: Always! But I'm not looking for any assistance from passing adventurers, if that's what you were thinking. Maybe another time.

if-the-25th-anniversary-event-was-comple.npc: Thank you so much for helping me open the Realm of Memories, [player name]!

options.text: What are you going to do now?

steps.player: What are you going to do now?

steps.npc: I'm a qualified wizard now, thanks to you. So I've settled here, near a handy rune shop, so I can keep practicing the magical arts while I raise this cat that some local lady persuaded me to buy.
Maybe I'll need your help with another project in future, but for now, I think I'm okay.
